title: I got tired of grinding Kingshot, so I spent four weeks building my own kingdom builder
author: thecrownforge
selftext:
I got tired of the grind in Kingshot and thought: surely I can make something better, more interesting, and prettier myself. A very modest and completely reasonable plan.

Four weeks of prompting, describing game mechanics, testing, and explaining why “technically working” isn’t quite the same as fun later… this is Crownforge.

I’ve always loved crafting and in-game economies. The direction I want to take this is a kingdom where gathering, crafting, production chains, and trade feed into each other. 

I want the choices about what you make and how you use it to be worth thinking about. That’s still something I’m building towards.

The toolbox so far: Codex, Claude Code, [Leonardo.Ai](http://Leonardo.Ai), ElevenLabs, Modal, Render, MuseTalk, and AIVA. A lot of the work has been describing how the systems should fit together, then playing what comes back and figuring out what needs changing. Over 400 fixes done already and I think another 600 are to be done. 

This clip mixes Elira’s AI-made character cinematic with actual beta gameplay. The cinematic shots are done by Seedance 2.5 with a direct directing from me. The city-building, hero selection, and battles are recorded from the game.

Anyone else here started making a game because another one annoyed them enough?
